verdict.rationale: Omnara explicitly markets itself as 'the open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents' and states it is 'Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0,' with a public GitHub repository confirming the source is available. Missing for 10: independent verification of full license scope/completeness (e.g., some components possibly closed-source) and community confirmation of actual code openness beyond vendor claims.
